narrative_markdown:
## Today's Forecast

Slightly cooler and cloudier than yesterday; winds little changed. Showery from the afternoon, with thunder possible from the morning, peaking this evening. 30°C / 86°F high, 20°C / 67°F low. Sky mostly cloudy through the day. Wind NE early and SW at midday; gusts to 42 km/h (23 kt). UV index 9.2 (very high). Air quality 74 (moderate), by the CAMS model. As of 06:01, reports through 02:00: no rain; no thunder; high so far 22°C / 72°F; low so far 21°C / 70°F; peak sustained 13 km/h; sky partly cloudy.

## Extended Outlook

Temperatures and winds much the same through Sunday, with showers and thunderstorms likely each day. Skies mostly cloudy throughout. Sunday's call: rain, 100%, with all four models wet; highs 28 to 30 °C. At this lead Best Match has the best record, right 80% of the time over 75 checks.

Further out, temperatures and winds much the same through Thursday, with showers and thunderstorms likely Monday and Tuesday, and showers and thunderstorms possible Wednesday and Thursday. Monday: three of four models wet, highs around 29 °C. Tuesday: all four models wet, highs much the same. Wednesday: two of three models wet, highs around 30 °C, thunder possible rather than likely.

Only GFS, ECMWF and ICON reach past Tuesday. ICON is the wetter solution from Monday to Tuesday; GFS, ECMWF and UKMO keep it drier. Thursday's call: rain, 100%, with both models wet; highs around 31 °C. At this lead ECMWF has the best record, right 80% of the time over 71 checks.

## Severe Weather / Hazard Potential

Convective instability today: UKMO 3340 J/kg, ICON 1640 J/kg, ECMWF 1620 J/kg and GFS 880 J/kg. Thunder likely; any thunderstorm brings sudden gusts well above the 42 km/h (23 kt) forecast.

## Winam Gulf — Conditions for Boaters

Peak gust 35 km/h (19 kt). Any thunderstorm brings sudden gusts well above this figure; the water is unsafe while one is nearby.

## Detailed Discussion

### Synoptic Overview

Across roughly 2,600 km, pressure is lowest toward the north (1008 hPa) and highest toward the northeast (1013 hPa) — a 6 hPa spread, a moderate large-scale gradient. Pressure overhead is near-steady. Sampling is a nine-point ring at 12-degree spacing, so this locates a direction, not a centre or a front. Across the basin's 5 points, pressure today sits between 1013.6 and 1015.6 hPa, near-steady over three days (+0.6 hPa). Pressure here over the last 24 hours: +1.9 hPa.

### Forecaster Confidence Notes

On rain the record ranks Best Match first at Day+3, right 80% of the last 30 checks and ECMWF first at Day+7, right 80% of the last 30 checks. On today's high GFS is the warmest model at 31.3 °C and ICON the coolest at 27.7 °C; the call's 30.2 °C sits between them. At Day+0, no model is meaningfully better than the others here yet. At Day+7, ECMWF is the strongest rain caller here and GFS the weakest. At Day+0, Best Match slightly under-forecasts peak wind here.

Figures issued 06:01. Written by code; a discussion follows when a model answers.
